verse.verse_1: When the sky is rent asunder,
verse.verse_2: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord, and it must needs (do so);-
verse.verse_3: And when the earth is flattened out,
verse.verse_4: And casts forth what is within it and becomes (clean) empty,
verse.verse_5: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord,- and it must needs (do so);- (then will come Home the full reality).
verse.verse_6: O thou man! Verily thou art ever toiling on towards thy Lord- painfully toiling,- but thou shalt meet Him.
verse.verse_7: Then he who is given his Record in his right hand,
verse.verse_8: Soon will his account be taken by an easy reckoning,
verse.verse_9: And he will turn to his people, rejoicing!
verse.verse_10: But he who is given his Record behind his back,-
verse.verse_11: Soon will he cry for perdition,
verse.verse_12: And he will enter a Blazing Fire.
verse.verse_13: Truly, did he go about among his people, rejoicing!
verse.verse_14: Truly, did he think that he would not have to return (to Us)!
verse.verse_15: Nay, nay! for his Lord was (ever) watchful of him!
verse.verse_16: So I do call to witness the ruddy glow of Sunset;
verse.verse_18: And the Moon in her fullness:
verse.verse_19: Ye shall surely travel from stage to stage.
verse.verse_20: What then is the matter with them, that they believe not?-
verse.verse_21: And when the Qur'an is read to them, they fall not prostrate,
verse.verse_22: But on the contrary the Unbelievers reject (it).
verse.verse_23: But Allah has full knowledge of what they secrete (in their breasts)
verse.verse_24: So announce to them a Penalty Grievous,
verse.verse_25: Except to those who believe and work righteous deeds: For them is a Reward that will never fail.
